title: Locate and Identify the Target Component
description: Find the component containing the 'API Key Management' text and Key icon that needs to be updated for the AI Schedule Auditor application.
details: Search the codebase starting with app/dashboard/page.tsx for the text string 'API Key Management' to locate the exact component implementation. Examine the component structure to identify the current Lucide React icon being used (likely <Key />) and understand the surrounding Card component structure with CardTitle and CardDescription. Document the file location and component hierarchy for the subsequent updates.
test_strategy: Manual verification by running the development server and visually confirming the location of the component on the dashboard page. Take a screenshot before changes for comparison.

title: Replace Icon and Update Component Content
description: Replace the current Key icon with a contextually appropriate icon for the AI Schedule Auditor and update the title and description text.
details: Import a suitable replacement icon from lucide-react (such as Bot, CalendarDays, or Sparkles) that aligns with AI scheduling functionality. Replace the existing Key icon component while preserving all CSS classes for size, color, and alignment. Update the CardTitle from 'API Key Management' to something more relevant like 'AI Configuration' or 'Schedule Settings'. Update the CardDescription to reflect the new purpose, such as 'Configure AI model preferences and scheduling parameters' or similar contextually appropriate text.
test_strategy: Visual testing in development environment to ensure the new icon renders correctly with proper styling and the updated text displays appropriately within the card layout. Verify no layout shifts or styling issues occur.

title: Verify Integration and Visual Consistency
description: Ensure the updated component maintains visual consistency with the overall dashboard design and functions properly within the application context.
details: Test the updated component across different screen sizes to ensure responsive behavior is maintained. Verify that the new icon's stroke width, size, and color match the existing design system. Check that the updated text content fits well within the card boundaries and maintains proper typography hierarchy. Ensure the component still integrates properly with any surrounding dashboard elements and navigation.
test_strategy: Cross-browser testing on Chrome, Firefox, and Safari. Test responsive behavior on desktop and tablet viewports. Compare with other dashboard components to ensure visual consistency. Perform a final visual regression check against the original screenshot.
